entries.title: Genesis 22:1
segments:
Tempt Abraham; try him; prove the genuineness and strength of his faith. 
 
The children of God, while in this world, must expect trials; and often, the most severe come last.  But they need not despond.  If they trust in God, he will sustain them and cause them to triumph.

entries.title: Genesis 22:2
segments:
The land of Moriah; in which Jerusalem and the temple were afterwards built. 
 
As God is the giver and preserver of life, he has a perfect right to direct when and how it shall be taken away.  Though to take life in opposition to his known will is murder, and subjects the murderer to his curse, to do it in obedience to his command is a duty, and will receive from him a gracious and glorious reward.

entries.title: Genesis 22:5
segments: I and the lad will--come again; he thought that God would raise Isaac from the dead, or in some way restore him, even if offered as a sacrifice.
To believe heartily and fully the divine declarations, and expect their fulfilment, it is not necessary to know, or be able to conceive, how they can be accomplished.

entries.title: Genesis 22:7
segments: Where is the lamb; Isaac knew that Abraham was going to offer a burnt-offering, but did not know that he intended to sacrifice him.

entries.title: Genesis 22:8
segments: A permanent conviction that God will provide, is an anchor to the soul, sure and steadfast.  Under its influence, though the winds rage and the tempests roar, men may outride the storm, and in due time calmly and joyfully enter the port.

entries.title: Genesis 22:12
segments: Now I know; it had been made evident that Abraham regarded God more than he did Isaac, or any creature.  Let God command what he might, Abraham would obey.

entries.title: Genesis 22:14
segments:
Jehovah-jireh; meaning, the Lord will provide. 
 
  As it is said to this day; said as a proverb. 
 
  It shall be seen; rather it shall be provided.  Hence the proverb, "Man's extremity is God's opportunity."

entries.title: Genesis 22:15
segments: Angel of the Lord; here, as often elsewhere, Jehovah himself.

entries.title: Genesis 22:17
segments: Possess the gate; be victorious over all their foes.

entries.title: Genesis 22:18
segments: Fidelity under great trials is peculiarly pleasing to God and useful to men.  It will receive special tokens of divine favor, and be followed by a rich and lasting reward.

entries.title: Genesis 22:23
segments: Rebekah; her father was Abraham's nephew, and cousin to Isaac, whom she afterwards married.
